text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Rinrin's outfit's real cool lookin', huh?
Wearin' that armor to do security at the ranch... ain't likely, huh?
Shame, really.
choice_data_list: She wants to take special care of it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
リンリンの衣装、
カッコいいなぁ。
あの鎧を着て
牧場の警備をしてくれるリンリン……
は
想像がつかねぇな。
残念ながら。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Ya think so? But I get the feelin' she'll be full of nothin' but excuses,
an' then she'll try'n get away. I need to think of a reason for her to
keep wearin' it, but I ain't good at that sorta thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだべか？
　
いろいろ言い訳されて
逃げられちまう気しかしねぇなぁ。
言い負かせるだけの理由を見つけられりゃあいいのかもしんねぇけど、
オラ
そういうのは苦手だからなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's best not to need it. But ya know, it'll be a shame not to be
able to see her like that anymore. If I tell her she can slack off when
she's wearing the armor, do ya think she will?
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに
着ねぇに越したことはねぇな。
んー
でも
あのリンリンが見られなくなるのは
惜しいなぁ。
鎧を着てるときはサボっていい、
って言えば
着てくれっかな？

text_block_list.name: Mahiru
text_block_list.text:
She did say it was a gift from her mom, didn't she?
So of course she'd wanna keep it safe.
...Well, that's what she should be sayin'.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お母さんからもらったもん
って言ってたな。
そりゃあ確かに
大切にしときたいのも分かるべ。
……言ってるのが
リンリンじゃなきゃな。
